name: formule
description: FORMULE — interface universelle de pilotage (UCI), mono-utilisateur, locale.

scripts.start: npm run build -w @formule/frontend && FORMULE_SERVE_STUDIO=1 concurrently -k --names sto,hub,val,apps,voice,ai,gw "npm:start -w @formule/storage" "npm:start -w @formule/mcp-hub" "npm:start -w @formule/validator" "npm:start -w @formule/app-agents" "npm:start -w @formule/voice-gateway" "npm:start -w @formule/ai-engine" "npm:start -w @formule/api-gateway"
